title: Language Model Integration
summary: This module orchestrates all interactions with Language Models in DSPy, providing clients for diverse LMs, flexible data adapters for structured inputs/outputs, and robust caching and streaming capabilities. It ensures seamless, efficient, and adaptable communication with LMs.

nodes.label: Manage LM Connections
nodes.title: Language Model Clients
nodes.description: Handles direct communication with various Language Models (LMs), managing requests, responses, and provider-specific integrations.

nodes.label: Adapt Data for LMs
nodes.title: Data Adapters
nodes.description: Transforms DSPy signatures and inputs into LM-compatible formats and parses LM responses back into structured DSPy outputs, supporting advanced features like tool calling.

nodes.label: Cache & Stream Responses
nodes.title: Caching & Streaming
nodes.description: Provides mechanisms for caching LM responses to improve efficiency and enables real-time streaming of outputs, enhancing user experience and responsiveness.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Logic
nodes.title: DSPy Base Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy programs, orchestrating the use of LMs, adapters, and other components to execute complex tasks.

nodes.label: Define LM Interaction
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: A declarative specification of input and output fields for an LM call, guiding how prompts are constructed and responses are expected.

nodes.label: Standardized LM Request
nodes.title: LMRequest Object
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing a request to a Language Model, encapsulating messages, tools, and configuration.

nodes.label: Standardized LM Response
nodes.title: LMResponse Object
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing the response from a Language Model, including generated outputs, usage, and metadata.

groups.label: LM Clients & Core Interaction
groups.title: Language Model Core Interaction
groups.description: Components responsible for direct communication with various Language Models, handling requests and receiving responses.

groups.label: Data Adapters & Signatures
groups.title: Data Adapters and Signatures
groups.description: Modules that define how DSPy programs structure inputs for LMs and parse their outputs, leveraging declarative signatures.

groups.label: Performance & Real-time Output
groups.title: Caching and Streaming Mechanisms
groups.description: Enhances efficiency through caching and provides real-time, incremental output delivery from Language Models.

groups.label: DSPy Program Foundation
groups.title: DSPy Program Integration
groups.description: The fundamental building block for DSPy programs, which orchestrates the use of LM clients and data adapters.
